_comment: Approximate average residential electricity prices per kWh, local currency. Manually curated, to be refreshed periodically. Exchange rates to USD are fetched live from frankfurter.app (ECB rates) at dashboard startup.

USA.source: EIA average residential retail electricity price, 2024

China.source: Average residential tariff, tiered pricing varies by province, ~2024

DR Congo.source: Approximate SNEL residential rate; USD used directly since the Congolese Franc (CDF) is not tracked by the exchange-rate API and public data is scarce/volatile. High uncertainty.

Brazil.source: ANEEL average residential tariff including taxes, ~2024
